import os
path='/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1790689749/attempts/31c36fde4a524b3f9529214b2feb9fae/system/state/workspace/programs/task-0c04a6e6.py'
os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(path),exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    # The non-background object is the stencil. Copy its colored-cell mask
    # onto every translated location whose corresponding cells are zero.
    g = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(g), len(g[0])
    colors = {v for row in g for v in row if v not in (0,)}
    # Background is the most frequent nonzero color; the stencil color is
    # the remaining isolated foreground color in these tasks.
    from collections import Counter, deque
    cnt = Counter(v for row in g for v in row)
    bg = cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    fg = [c for c in cnt if c not in (bg, 0)]
    if not fg:
        return g
    # Foreground object is the smallest color component (the unique marker).
    color = min(fg, key=lambda c: sum(v == c for row in g for v in row))
    pts = [(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c] == color]
    if not pts:
        return g
    r0=min(r for r,c in pts); c0=min(c for r,c in pts)
    shape={(r-r0,c-c0) for r,c in pts}
    sh=max(r for r,c in shape)+1; sw=max(c for r,c in shape)+1
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    for i in range(h-sh+1):
        for j in range(w-sw+1):
            cells=[(i+r,j+c) for r,c in shape]
            if all(g[r][c] == 0 for r,c in cells):
                for r,c in cells: out[r][c]=color
    return out
'''
open(path,'w').write(code)
print(path, os.path.getsize(path))
